_comment: Every model of samples/aetherbound, the profile it is judged by, the flaws it is allowed to keep (each with a reason and a cap, so it cannot grow), and its visual review. `python3 tools/modelkit/validate.py --manifest tools/aetherbound/models.json` must pass; see tools/modelkit/README.md. A waiver that starts 'Known debt' is a flaw to remove the next time its generator is touched: fix it, then delete the waiver.

review.by: Claude (AI agent), from the review sheet with engine shots
review.notes: Reads as a crystal splinter in silhouette at game size; six hard facets, clean clay view, even texel density; violet with a white core matches the aetherite palette of SPEC.md and the big crystal.

uv.texel_density.reason: By design: a 14-unit crystal that hangs over the tower and is only seen from the courtyard, through bloom; 13 to 14 px per unit from one 512 texture is enough there. Raise it if a scene ever brings the camera close.

review.by: Claude (AI agent), from the review sheet with engine shots
review.notes: Strong spiky silhouette with four orbiting satellites; facets are hard and clean with no faces seen from behind; glows violet-white in the engine as SPEC.md asks. Texel density is under the profile (waived: distant set piece).

normals.shading.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: the thin rims of the armour plates and trim bands (5% of the surface) take the normal of the plate they border, so they shade as a soft bevel instead of a hard edge. Fix in tools/aetherbound/colossus/build_colossus.py: modelkit_bpy.clean(obj, sharp_angle=40) before export.

topology.ngons.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: six flat plates of up to 28 corners left to the exporter's triangulation. Fix in build_colossus.py: build them from quads, or clean() so the triangulation is chosen.

topology.coplanar_overlap.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: four faces of overlapping parts in one plane. Fix in build_colossus.py: inset one part or cut the hidden face.

review.by: Claude (AI agent), from the review sheet with engine shots
review.notes: Re-reviewed after its normal map's green was flipped with the engine's tangent fix. Mesh, rig and animations verified identical to the reviewed file, accessor by accessor. In the new engine shots the plates, trim and rivets are lit as before and the poses hold together; the Colossus battle replay still matches its reference screenshots. Earlier verdict and waivers stand.

integrity.non_manifold_edges.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: blocks that share an edge are fused without removing the faces between them. Fix in tools/aetherbound/fortress/build.py.

normals.flipped.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: 67 small faces of props and walls wound the wrong way. Fix in fortress/build.py: modelkit_bpy.clean() recalculates them.

normals.shading.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: props smoothed across their hard edges (6% of the props' surface). Fix in fortress/build.py: clean(obj, sharp_angle=40).

topology.ngons.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: one 26-corner slab triangulated by the exporter.

topology.t_junctions.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: walls, rock and mist sheets built from pieces whose edges do not meet vertex to vertex; can show as pinhole cracks. Fix in fortress/build.py by cutting the long edge where the neighbour ends.

topology.coplanar_overlap.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: props laid flat on one another in the same plane (planks, debris, cloth); can z-fight. Fix in fortress/build.py: lift each layer by a few millimetres.

uv.texel_density.reason: By design: the mist is a soft gradient on large sheets; 8 px per unit shows no texels.

uv.collapsed.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: 1% of the props' surface has UVs collapsed to a line (edge-on faces in the box projection). Fix in fortress/build.py with modelkit_bpy.box_unwrap.

review.by: Claude (AI agent), from the map review sheet and the replay captures of the game
review.notes: Re-signed after its five normal maps' green was flipped with the engine's tangent fix. Geometry verified identical to the reviewed file, accessor by accessor, and the opening replay (bridge, gate, courtyard) still matches its reference screenshots. The flaws noted before (tower parapets, a few props) are unchanged and stay listed as debt.

integrity.degenerate_faces.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: the generator emits collapsed triangles (they draw nothing, they only cost). Fix in tools/aetherbound/chamber/build.py: modelkit_bpy.clean() before export.

integrity.non_manifold_edges.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: stone pieces fused along an edge with the faces between them left in. Fix in chamber/build.py.

topology.ngons.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: floor discs and plates of up to 102 corners triangulated by the exporter. Fix in chamber/build.py: build discs as rings of quads around a centre.

topology.t_junctions.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: pieces whose edges do not meet vertex to vertex. Fix in chamber/build.py.

topology.coplanar_overlap.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: faces of touching pieces in one plane; can z-fight. Fix in chamber/build.py.

review.by: Claude (AI agent), from the map review sheet and the replay captures of the game
review.notes: Round chamber with dais, tanks, pipes and brass ring reads well from the game camera; texel density even on everything walked on (the skirt below the floor is low and never close). The wall piers have no top caps: they end far above the camera's frame in every scene.

integrity.degenerate_faces.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: the generator emits collapsed triangles (they draw nothing, they only cost). Fix in tools/aetherbound/chamber/build.py: modelkit_bpy.clean() before export.

integrity.non_manifold_edges.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: stone pieces fused along an edge with the faces between them left in. Fix in chamber/build.py.

topology.t_junctions.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: rubble and wall pieces whose edges do not meet vertex to vertex. Fix in chamber/build.py.

topology.ngons.reason: Known debt from before modelkit: one 68-corner slab triangulated by the exporter.

review.by: Claude (AI agent), from the map review sheet and the replay captures of the game
review.notes: The same footprint broken open: crater at the dais, standing wall stumps, rubble field; forms read from the game camera and texel density is even. No faces seen from behind in the play area.
